say:7:1520803005:0.source_cn: 哦哦，是神使和伟大的狩猎神本尊！

choice_prompt:9:1520803006.text: I was just telling the young ones about the Bloodhunt Festival. They're all dreaming of becoming your chosen warrior.

say:12:1520803007:0.text: Come on, Furblade! Tell us about the last Bloodhunt Festival!
say:12:1520803007:0.source_cn: 毛锋，你刚刚说到要给我们讲上一次的猎血节！快点讲吧！

say:13:1520803008:0.source_cn: 好好好。上一次的猎血节，一共有三十位英勇的战士参加，每...

say:15:1520803009:0.source_cn: 正式选拔的那天，丛林里异常安静。平时凶猛的野兽就像预感...

say:17:1520803010:0.text: No way! The Bloodhunt Festival happened during the rainy season when beasts are most active. They wouldn't just go silent!
say:17:1520803010:0.source_cn: 不可能。猎血节是在野兽出没最频繁的雨季举行，怎么可能一...

say:18:1520803011:0.source_cn: 为啥不可能？野兽肯定是被战士们吓得不敢出声！

say:19:1520803012:0.text: You knumbskull! One warrior survived last time, which means the forest was scoured clean of beasts. Nothing was left to hide!
say:19:1520803012:0.source_cn: 你是呆子吗？上次猎血节只有一位战士存活。被狩猎的野兽怎...

say:20:1520803013:0.text: Call me a knumbskull again, and I'll knock your teeth out!
say:20:1520803013:0.source_cn: ……再说我是呆子，我就要和你决斗了！

say:23:1520803014:0.text: You want to fight over a simple story? Have you no self-respect?
say:23:1520803014:0.source_cn: 好了。听个故事都能打起来，你们是哪来的莽夫？

say:24:1520803015:0.text: If you've got so much energy, practice your swordwork and archery. At this rate, you won't even qualify for the Bloodhunt Festival, let alone earn the Herdmaster's blessing!

say:24:1520803015:0.female: If you've got so much energy, practice your swordwork and archery. At this rate, you won't even qualify for the Bloodhunt Festival, let alone earn the Herdmaster's blessing!

say:25:1520803016:0.text: Stop acting like you're better than me! You want to go? I'm not afraid of you!

narration:26:1520803017:0.text: Despite Furblade's attempts to restore order, the young Wildborn started fighting each other.
narration:26:1520803017:0.source_cn: 无论毛锋怎么劝阻，几位年轻的兽人都听不进去

narration:27:1520803018:0.text: Seeing no other choice, you unleash a beam of magic, knocking the weapons from their hands.
narration:27:1520803018:0.source_cn: 无奈之下，你扔出一道魔法光束，打掉了他们手中的武器
narration:27:1520803018:0.male: Seeing no other choice, you unleash a beam of magic, knocking the weapons from their hands.
narration:27:1520803018:0.female: Seeing no other choice, you unleash a beam of magic, knocking the weapons from their hands.

say:30:1520804001:0.text: How many times must I tell you to stop?

say:31:1520804002:0.text: Now you've angered the Great Hunting God and brought his wrath upon yourselves!

say:31:1520804002:0.male: Now you've angered the Great Hunting God and brought his wrath upon yourselves!
say:31:1520804002:0.female: Now you've angered the Great Hunting Goddess and brought her wrath upon yourselves!

say:34:1520804003:0.text: That power... was that divine punishment?!
say:34:1520804003:0.source_cn: 那股强大的力量……是神罚？！

say:36:1520804004:0.text: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
say:36:1520804004:0.source_cn: 你们在狩猎神面前失态，应当受到惩罚。
say:36:1520804004:0.male: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
say:36:1520804004:0.female: You showed disrespect before the Hunting Goddess. Punishment is deserved.

choice_prompt:37:1520804004.text: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.

choice_prompt:37:1520804004.female: You showed disrespect before the Hunting Goddess. Punishment is deserved.

say:40:1520804005:0.source_cn: 原谅我们！我们一定会认真思过！

say:41:1520804006:0.text: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.

say:41:1520804006:0.male: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.
say:41:1520804006:0.female: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.

say:42:1520804007:0.text: Their behavior brings shame to all Wildborn.
say:42:1520804007:0.source_cn: 他们太轻浮了，实在是有辱雅库伯尔对他们的教导。

say:42:1520804007:0.female: Their behavior brings shame to all Wildborn.

say:45:1520804010:0.male: Yes! Since childhood, I've dreamed of winning the Bloodhunt Festival and becoming your chosen warrior!

say:46:1520804011:0.female: Especially after witnessing your power—I pledge my eternal loyalty and dedicate my life to this goal!

choice:37:0:1.text: Reflect on the errors of your ways.

choice:37:0:1.female: Reflect on the errors of your ways.

say:4:1520805003:0.source_cn: 闭嘴。狩猎神还在这里，还轮不到你说话。
say:4:1520805003:0.male: Silence. Not in front of the Herdmaster.
say:4:1520805003:0.female: Silence. Not in front of the Herdmaster.

say:8:1520805006:0.text: Kordan, don't be so harsh on Oboe just because she's your daughter. Look, she's trembling like a frightened kitten.
say:8:1520805006:0.source_cn: 唉……戈丹，别因为你的身份就对欧布格外严格。她怕你都怕...

narration:10:1520805008:0.source_cn: 毛锋将争吵的来龙去脉告诉了戈丹……

say:11:1520805009:0.text: So, you fought over who gets to take part in the Bloodhunt Festival?
say:11:1520805009:0.source_cn: ……所以，你们这几个年轻人是在为了猎血节的选拔而争执？

say:24:1520805014:0.text: At least you showed spirit—I would have expected no less from Wildborn warriors!
say:24:1520805014:0.source_cn: 不错，你们几个很有志气。这才像是雅库伯尔战士该有的气概！

say:25:1520805015:0.text: But fighting in the presence of the Herdmaster? Such disrespect demands punishment!
say:25:1520805015:0.source_cn: 但你们竟敢在伟大的雅库伯尔之月面前互相争执，大打出手。...

choice_prompt:26:1520805015.text: But fighting in the presence of the Herdmaster? Such disrespect demands punishment!
choice_prompt:26:1520805015.source_cn: 但你们竟敢在伟大的雅库伯尔之月面前互相争执，大打出手。做出这样无礼的行径，必须得到惩罚和教育！

say:27:1520805016:0.text: We can't go easy on our young warriors. This is when they need discipline most.
say:27:1520805016:0.source_cn: 不要对这些年轻的战士仁慈，他们现在正是最需要磨砺的年纪。

say:27:1520805016:0.female: We can't go easy on our young warriors. This is when they need discipline most.

say:28:1520805017:0.text: But, I won't defy the Herdmaster. I'll lighten their punishments accordingly.
say:28:1520805017:0.source_cn: 不过，我不会违抗兽群之主的意志，会酌情放轻处罚。

say:28:1520805017:0.female: But, I won't defy the Herdmaster. I'll lighten their punishments accordingly.

say:29:1520805019:0.text: I-I'm sorry! I won't do it again, don't punish me...
say:29:1520805019:0.source_cn: 我、我……我知错了，不要惩罚我……！

say:32:1520805020:0.text: Kordan, Sai is just a kid. Let him off—I'll take his punishment!
say:32:1520805020:0.source_cn: 戈丹，飒的年纪比我还小，你就饶了他这一回吧。我可以替他受罚！

say:34:1520805022:0.text: Fine. Since you two stepped forward, follow me.
say:34:1520805022:0.source_cn: 好。既然你们两个主动承担责任，那就跟我来。

choice_prompt:37:1520805022.text: Fine. Since you two stepped forward, follow me.
choice_prompt:37:1520805022.source_cn: 好。既然你们两个主动承担责任，那就跟我来。

say:38:1520805023:0.text: To the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>. They'll be punished there.
say:38:1520805023:0.male: To the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>. They'll be punished there.
say:38:1520805023:0.female: To the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>. They'll be punished there.

say:39:1520805026:0.text: With you as witness, Great Herdmaster, they'll never forget today's lesson.

say:39:1520805026:0.female: With you as witness, Great Herdmaster, they'll never forget today's lesson.

say:41:1520805024:0.text: Of course not. I only hit them on the head during training.
say:41:1520805024:0.source_cn: 当然不。我只会在进行战士训练的时候揍他们。
say:41:1520805024:0.male: Of course not. I only hit them on the head during training.
say:41:1520805024:0.female: Of course not. I only hit them on the head during training.

say:42:1520805025:0.text: Right now, we're heading to the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>, where their punishment awaits.

say:42:1520805025:0.male: Right now, we're heading to the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>, where their punishment awaits.
say:42:1520805025:0.female: Right now, we're heading to the <style="highlight">forest south of the valley</style>, where their punishment awaits.

choice:37:1:2.text: You're not hurting them, are you?
choice:37:1:2.male: You're not hurting them, are you?
choice:37:1:2.female: You're not hurting them, are you?

choice:26:0:1.text: No need to be so harsh.

choice:26:0:1.female: No need to be so harsh.

choice:26:1:2.text: Yes, they need a proper lesson!
choice:26:1:2.male: Yes, they need a proper lesson!
choice:26:1:2.female: Yes, they need a proper lesson!

say:0:1520807001:0.text: Before you lies the remnants of old hunting traps. Their spikes jutted out like crooked teeth, rusty hinges seized up and useless.
say:0:1520807001:0.source_cn: 捕兽陷阱的尖刺全部歪斜着，机关也早已失灵，被破坏得非常彻底。

say:4:1520807002:1.text: ...So our punishment is just... fixing these traps?
say:4:1520807002:1.source_cn: ……我们的惩罚就是修理这些陷阱吗？

say:7:1520807005:1.text: <style="highlight">Look around you</style>. Use your eyes and ears.

say:3:1520808001:1.text: These tracks... they're paw prints of <style="highlight">wild wolves</style>. They're fresh too.

say:4:1520808002:1.text: And the sun's setting. The wolves will start hunting soon.
say:4:1520808002:1.source_cn: 天快黑了，丛林里的野狼马上就要出来活动了……

say:7:1520808003:1.text:
Exactly.
Your punishment, Grift and Oboe, is to survive the night in this wolf-infested forest.
say:7:1520808003:1.source_cn: 没错。\n在野狼出没的丛林里度过一夜，这就是费斗和欧布...

say:8:1520808004:1.text: Remember, a Wildborn warrior's blade must never turn against their comrades, only against enemies. That will be your lesson!
say:8:1520808004:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔战士的刀刃和箭矢只能面向敌人，决不允许指向同伴...

say:9:1520808005:1.text: But there are too many wolves here! Just the two of us can't possibly...
say:9:1520808005:1.source_cn: 可是丛林里的野狼那么多，只靠我和欧布两个人根本对付不了！

say:10:1520808006:1.text: Then use what you've learned! Traps, stealth, ambush tactics. Everything I've taught you.
say:10:1520808006:1.source_cn: 运用你们学到的技巧！陷阱，躲藏，埋伏。该用的都用上。

say:11:1520808007:1.text: Or are you telling me that Wildborn warriors hoping to fight in the Bloodhunt Festival are going to cower before a few wolves?
say:11:1520808007:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔的战士难道会因为区区几只野狼就退缩？

say:13:1520808009:0.text: But if... if Grift and I prove ourselves tonight, then by tradition, we should be rewarded.
say:13:1520808009:0.source_cn: 如果……如果我和费斗证明了自己，按照雅库伯尔的规矩，我...

say:14:1520808010:0.text: Oh? And what do you want?

say:15:1520808011:0.text: ...I don't want anything from you, Father.

say:18:1520808012:0.text: O Great Herdmaster, I humbly request... if we survive and prove our worth, grant us a weapon as our prize!

say:18:1520808012:0.female: O Great Herdmaster, I humbly request... if we survive and prove our worth, grant us a weapon as our prize!
